name: Juventus (Trapattoni era) 1976-86
scopeNote: Juventus under Giovanni Trapattoni, appointed 1976-07-01 (July 1976 per TFT). Start = first official match, Coppa Italia at Monza 1976-08-29 (1-1, Boninsegna), per juventus.com; end = last league match, Lecce 2-3 Juventus 1986-04-27 (22nd scudetto); no later competitive match found (Coppa Italia exit date not found, earlier in the season). Style term used by sources: catenaccio adapted into zona mista (man-marking plus zonal), libero Scirea, counter-attacks, later a more attacking phase with Platini (1982-86). Era changes: 1976-80 all-Italian team (UEFA Cup 1977 without foreigners, per a search summary only); 1980-82 Brady; 1982-86 Platini and Boniek. Almost all tactical sources are later retrospectives (retrospectiveOnly true); no tier A source or dated contemporary quote found. 1975/76 and 1986/87 (Marchesi) facts excluded.
openQuestions: No contemporary or tier A source found for pressing, build-up or the 1985 final tactics; the 1982-86 'attacking phase' rests on one TFT line.
Trapattoni quotes are attributed (Il Foglio 2024), no primary dated source found; 'Il Trap' book and Jonathan Wilson not mined.
Exact Coppa Italia 1985/86 elimination date not found; end date assumes 1986-04-27 is last match.
UEFA Cup 1977 'only Italians' claim seen only in search summary (not verified).
